Name: PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
A kitchen sprite I made for my work-in-progress mod called Cherry Lake Tilesheet. Originally I only meant to make a simple kitchen replacement mod from the sprite, but I gave in to scope creep as usual :p

I've been amazed by how creative people design their farmhouse with Rattan, Old World, and my other decoration mods. Making buildable version (toggleable via config) so people will have more freedom to decorate sounds like a good enough reason for me. No catalogue for now, though. 


Have fun people, and happy decorating!
